vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (4 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Diana about A woman, maybe 60s. The retelling is already better than the event.
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek fixing something.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mia telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
A person, maybe 40s showed A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek the American Persimmon — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

🔥 The fire settles. Abdulmajeed has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A red moon rising between the trees, breathing — I put it down today." "The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers." "The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the person in their 40s mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." the man in his 40s, with a scarred cheek says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — w
You catch fragments by the fire — Finn telling A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Ruby about Victor. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling Ruby about Abdulmajeed. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (7 sticks now.)
🛡️ Sarah, Afanasy, Nathan and Ruby met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sarah, Afanasy, Nathan, Ruby are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Nathan — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Nathan chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Afanasy and Nathan met them at the door — 2 put down. Afanasy, Nathan are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Chantal met them at the door — 1 put down. Chantal is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Afanasy just put down The Eater... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Nathan Lee, 47 — an HVAC tech. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Phoenix Clause.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
